# VectraSyn

> Affordable, fast-turnaround digital services for small, medium and growing businesses: websites, apps, e-commerce, automation, and logo/branding. English-language site. Pricing available in INR (default), USD and AED.

## Site structure

- / — Home: overview of the four core services, pricing preview, proof-of-work preview, contact CTA.
- /pricing — Full service menu with list price and final price (50% off) in INR, USD or AED, plus a "What's included" detail per service.
- /book — Cart summary of selected services plus a consultation booking slot (Cal.com embed pending). No payment is taken.
- /proof-of-work — Case study grid. All slots are placeholders marked "Case Study Coming Soon".
- /about — Company story, how we work (Discover, Build, Launch, Support), payment terms, FAQ.
- /contact — Contact form, address placeholder, map placeholder, social icons.

## Core services

- Websites — fast, mobile-friendly business websites.
- Apps — focused mobile or web apps.
- Automation — simple pipelines connecting business tools.
- Logo & Branding — original logo and brand files.
- E-commerce / WooCommerce — custom-quoted online stores.

## Pricing (list price -> final price, 50% off unless noted)

- Website Only: INR 36,000 -> 22,000 | USD 700 -> 350 | AED 3,000 -> 1,500
- Simple Pipeline: INR 10,000 -> 5,000 | USD 200 -> 100 | AED 800 -> 400
- Logo Design: INR 10,000 -> 5,000 | USD 200 -> 100 | AED 800 -> 400
- GBP Setup: INR 12,000 -> 6,000 | USD 200 -> 100 | AED 800 -> 400
- App Only: INR 70,000 -> 35,000 | USD 1,200 -> 600 | AED 5,000 -> 2,500
- E-commerce / WooCommerce (custom quote): INR 60,000-1,60,000 -> starting from 30,000-80,000 | USD 2,400-6,000 -> 1,200-3,000 | AED 9,000-24,000 -> 4,500-12,000
- Bundle 1: INR 50,000 -> 25,000 | USD 900 -> 450 | AED 3,800 -> 1,900
- Bundle 2: INR 100,000 -> 50,000 | USD 1,800 -> 900 | AED 7,500 -> 3,750
- Monthly Maintenance: INR 16,000 -> 8,000/mo | USD 300 -> 150/mo | AED 1,200 -> 600/mo

## What's included (selected)

- Website Only: standalone site, no automation included, page count pending confirmation, standard stack and hosting pending confirmation.
- Simple Pipeline: one connection from site/social/form to Google Sheets or Airtable.
- Bundle 1: website (4 pages) + automation (1 connection) + logo design + Google Business Profile setup; INR 3,000/yr domain and maintenance after year 1.
- Bundle 2: everything in Bundle 1 + up to 2 extra pages + WhatsApp Business (catalogue, barcode, payment gateway) + SEO/AEO/GEO setup + GA4 analytics + 100 printed visiting cards with scan code (Hyderabad-exclusive) + custom add-ons on request.
- E-commerce: product catalogue setup, payment gateway integration, store configuration; scoped per client.

## Payment terms

- Deposit plus milestone schedule; exact percentages confirmed at contract signing (pending final confirmation).
- Deposit is non-refundable once the agreement is signed and the video consultation appointment is complete.
- If VectraSyn cannot fulfil the agreed scope, the client is refunded 70% of the amount paid.
- First 2 months after launch include free bug fixes.

## Notes

- Brand mark is the "VectraSyn" text wordmark; no logo image is used.
- No client testimonials, client names, or performance metrics are published yet.
- Company address, social profile URLs, hosting stack and working-model (hybrid) details are pending confirmation.
